title: Fravor's Joe Rogan interview draws Merrick into the topic

plain: A man named Merrick von Renenamp, talking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says it was late 2019 when he got pulled into the subject of unexplained flying objects. What drew him in, he says, was an interview that a Navy commander named David Fravor gave on Joe Rogan's show, a very popular long-form talk podcast. He tells it to explain how one widely heard interview started his own involvement.
